method: Independent struct/NumPy decoding of all 22 runs; no imports from analysis or validation modules; same fixed full grid and linear quantiles. Timing and memory recomputed from raw result/CSV.

checks.check: seed 0 CPU GPU actual state equality
seed 100000 CPU GPU actual state equality
seed 200000 CPU GPU actual state equality
seed 300000 CPU GPU actual state equality
seed 400000 CPU GPU actual state equality
seed 500000 CPU GPU actual state equality

review_scope: Observed synthetic fixture only; six seed offsets; three disjoint prespecified blocks; random stream independence not established.

measurement_scope.situation_time: Full situation start after stop check to CompleteSituation; includes field/setup work; final output drain is outside interval
measurement_scope.seed_to_end: Additional diagnostic interval from RecordSeed to CompleteSituation
measurement_scope.steady_sum: sum of full situation intervals 4..N; not process end-to-end or boundary wall time
measurement_scope.steady_boundary: observer boundary start after situation3/drain through end/drain; includes intervening setup gaps
measurement_scope.gpu_memory: device-wide used memory; not process VRAM
measurement_scope.device_kernel_time: per-situation difference of cumulative result_server_metrics.kernel_device_ms; CUDA events
measurement_scope.legacy_kernel_named_host_timers: fresh_kernel_ms, residual_kernel_ms, and kernel_total_ms include host launch, synchronization, and status-read time; nested in host roundtrips

diagnostic_review.SG2_signed_bias: All six primary biases are negative; magnitude 1.96e-7 to 8.63e-7. Block mean absolute bias / CPU interseed absolute bias <= 0.000203. Retain sign trend; no defect established at observed scale. No causal mechanism inferred.
diagnostic_review.tail: All block mean absolute backend P95/P99 differences remain below respective CPU contrasts. Largest ratio is 0.0503 for SG3 P99 block1. This is a diagnostic comparison, not a newly fitted gate.
diagnostic_review.peak: All 24 primary group/aggregate x seed CPU/GPU peak locations agree. Stored primary hour indices are zero-based within hours4..24, so add4 to obtain model hour.
diagnostic_review.zero: No whole-zero group or zero CPU block denominator occurs in measured science. Zero cells preserved. All decoded values nonnegative and finite. Synthetic zero tests must supply zero-branch coverage separately.
diagnostic_review.maps: Visually reviewed seed0 full-group CPU/GPU shared-scale time-mean and signed differences: no missing plume or relocated dominant peak; small signed downstream differences visible. Other seeds checked numerically.

visual_review.required_publication_correction: resolved in measured_v2: independently viewed corrected disjoint prespecified block labels
visual_review.optional_readability: resolved in measured_v2: independently viewed 1-Pearson r axis

remaining_integrity_dependency: Final integrated review must reconcile preflight, functional matrix, overlay zero-offset, freeze and original-input snapshot; this reviewer verified all 22 measured inputs, output decoding and seed states, not every functional run.

humanize.retained_candidate: Missing WDDM process VRAM limits interpretation; informative negation retained.
